name: Sapele

queries.query: Sapele Nigeria cadastral map parcel land registry official Delta State
queries.result: Results identified Delta State property-registration procedures, the Delta Ministry of Lands and Survey digitization/geo-referencing programme, the federal Surveyor-General, and historical Sapele cadastral references. No public Sapele parcel ID-plus-geometry endpoint was exposed.

queries.query: Sapele Nigeria land registry map parcel survey plan official Delta State
queries.result: Nigeria-local wording returned the same Delta State lands-registration and digitization sources plus a non-government Delta land-information explainer; no first-party public Sapele parcel geometry service was found. Nigeria has no single nationwide local language used for Delta land-registry service discovery, so Nigerian English was used for the local-language-equivalent query.

freshResearch.method: Web discovery followed by TLS-verified bounded GETs with ordinary public requests; no credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS disablement used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Delta State MDA Services page identifies the Property Registration and Land Based Administration Process and links Ministry of Lands & Survey C-of-O and land-administration procedures. It establishes the state registry/procedure custodian but exposes no public parcel geometry API.

Official Delta State reform-plan document names the Ministry of Lands & Survey and D'LARMS/technical team, describing digitization, a spatial map of land parcels, parcel geo-coordinates and geo-referenced boundaries. It describes the programme, not an accessible viewer or downloadable layer.
Official federal Surveyor-General site offers requests for cadastral surveys, maps and coordinates, but no anonymous Sapele parcel layer was exposed.

National Library repository copy of a 1967 Mid-Western Nigeria Gazette contains a historical Sapele cadastral-survey reference and parcel description; it is historical documentary evidence, not a current machine-readable public parcel service and no geometry was retained.

requests.assessment: Official Delta State property-registration page returned HTML; no map viewer configuration or anonymous parcel feature endpoint identified.
Official reform-plan PDF returned successfully; inspected content supports D'LARMS/digitization and parcel-map programme claims but contains no public query endpoint or safe parcel feature response.
Official federal surveyor-general homepage returned HTML; no Sapele parcel service exposed.
Third-party Delta Web Map shell returned HTML and stated JavaScript was required; it is not established as a Delta State cadastral custodian and no parcel response was requested or retained.
Non-government Delta land-information page returned HTML and explicitly says an official Delta search cannot yet be ordered through it; no source geometry or native parcel ID was used.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Sapele city/local-government area in Delta State, Nigeria, under the Delta State Ministry of Lands & Survey / D'LARMS land-administration programme.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: State-level registry/procedure and digitization programme evidence only; no anonymous parcel geometry scope verified.

remainingUncertainty: The current Delta State viewer/API route, access controls, parcel schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, update currency and citywide coverage remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved and never shifted; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made. Historical Sapele cadastral references do not establish current coverage.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect an officially exposed Delta State D'LARMS/map portal if one becomes discoverable and test only a bounded anonymous safe ID-plus-geometry query. Do not infer citywide absence from the unavailable viewer/API or unusable third-party map shell.
